description: This file defines the ImapHandlerFactory class, which is responsible for creating and managing instances of imap handlers in the SuiteCRM project. It handles the inclusion of related handler classes, test mode configurations, and external dependencies like ImapHandler, Imap2Handler, and their associated test classes.

classes.name: ImapHandlerFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for providing instances of imap handlers, supporting test mode and production mode, managing external dependencies, and maintaining configurability.

methods.name: setInterfaceObject
methods.description: Sets the handler interface object and logs the class being used.

methods.name: includeFakeInterface
methods.description: Includes the fake handler class file if it hasn't been loaded already.

methods.name: loadTestSettings
methods.description: Loads specific test settings for imap handlers based on saved configuration.

methods.name: getTestSettings
methods.description: Retrieves the current test settings from a file or defaults to a preset key.

methods.name: deleteTestSettings
methods.description: Removes the test settings file, resetting test mode.

methods.name: saveTestSettingsKey
methods.description: Saves a specific test setting key into a configuration file.

methods.name: getImapHandler
methods.description: Returns an imap handler instance, either in test mode or production mode, with proper configuration.

methods.name: areAllHandlersAvailable
methods.description: Checks whether all handler types are available for use.

methods.name: getHandlerClass
methods.description: Returns the class name for a requested handler type.

methods.name: getHandlers
methods.description: Provides a list of available handler types and their corresponding class names.
